name: @rogerchappel/postmaker
description: Grounded social draft generator with explicit claim status for agents.

scripts.check: node --check src/*.js && node --check bin/postmaker.js && node --check scripts/*.js
scripts.smoke: node bin/postmaker.js from-repo fixtures/source-repo --platform linkedin --platform x --angle problem --angle proof --out .tmp/posts && node bin/postmaker.js check .tmp/posts/post-pack.json --source fixtures/source-repo
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke && npm run docs:install-check && npm run release:registry

author: Roger Chappel
